Grad Cafe Analytics
===================

A Flask + PostgreSQL service that scrapes self-reported Grad Cafe admissions
results, cleans and loads them into a Module 3 ``applicants`` table, and renders an
Analysis page with **Pull Data** and **Update Analysis** buttons.

Module 4 adds a pytest suite with 100% coverage, a GitHub Actions workflow that
runs it against PostgreSQL, and this documentation.
